shadows.name: artifact-lift
shadows.purpose: A restrained lift for primary project media.

motion.name: artifact-follow
motion.value: 5px pointer-linked transform with a subtle background wash
motion.purpose: Keeps the XFC capture responsive on desktop without obscuring content.

narrative.overview: A dark editorial portfolio with an optional light theme, real project media, clear navigation, and a restrained blue accent.
keyCharacteristics: Real project artifacts lead the page
Editorial rows rather than card grids
dos: Use real screenshots and gameplay to support technical claims.
Keep copy grounded and directly tied to the work.
Use blue for actions, technical metadata, and active navigation.
donts: Do not use dark neon grids, glassy dashboard cards, or technical-grid decoration.
Do not use fake chat interfaces, mascots, or stock AI imagery.
Do not compress navigation or hero type below a comfortable reading scale.
Do not add decorative motion without a clear purpose.
